decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core business that has remained in the assortment into a second full year, management is likely to justify the development and production investment by keeping it.

The comfort insole is a more peripheral accessory that could be trimmed more easily than footwear lines, but its complementarity with the shoe offer and the firm's prior investment still favor retention.

The supportive insole has relatively limited public visibility and is therefore somewhat more exposed to portfolio rationalization, yet escalation of commitment and system fit with the footwear range still point to keeping it.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with its own page represents a visible commitment in a central innovation area, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after two years.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship and as part of the firm's stated direction, the public and strategic commitment makes withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.
